name: Teeth whitening (non-dental studio)

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: in-studio whitening, 60 min
services.story: The main story: an in-studio whitening, 60 minutes, with Gina, $199. A card is saved for the studio's $100 fee, and Alex pays at the front desk.

services.name: in-studio whitening (3-session package)
services.story: A 3-session package, $480, paid in full when booking. Each session uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: at-home whitening, 60 min
services.story: The main story: an at-home whitening at Alex's home with Ray, $349. A card is saved for the $150 fee, and Rosie texts the bill after the visit.

services.name: wedding party for 3, at a venue
services.story: A wedding party for 3 at a venue, $900: a $300 deposit when booked, and the rest billed after the whitening.

services.name: touch-up at home, 30 min, paid in full
services.story: A touch-up at home, 30 minutes, $129, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: one whitening session per visit, with a tech the client picks or any free one; a shade check; packages of sessions; a home or venue visit for a party
questions_before_times: the service wanted (in-studio, a touch-up, a package, or a party) and the shade wanted
a tech by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
at home or at a venue: the town, the place, and how many people
for a party: the date and the time of the event
safety_stop: tooth pain, a swollen face or gums, pus, a broken or loose tooth, or bleeding gums
trouble breathing, chest pain, or fainting
license: none checked by Rosie: a non-dental studio whitens teeth as a cosmetic service; it never cleans, fills, diagnoses or treats teeth. Where a state's dental rules limit whitening outside a dental office, the owner must not book it (the owner's own decision; Rosie checks nothing)
staff_skills: in-studio and at-home whitening with a gel and a light; touch-ups; shade checks; no cleaning, polishing, fillings, extractions or diagnosis
messages_never: dental answers, health answers, pregnancy, medicines and the tech's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
